 CBSE board exam timetable 2027: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to announce the board exam timetable for the academic year 2026-27 soon on its official website, cbse.gov.in . Once released, this will give Class 10 and 12 students clarity on their upcoming 2027 board exam schedule . 
 Why an Early Timetable Helps Students? 
 With the release of the CBSE 10th and 12th date sheet 2027 , students will be able to prepare structured study plans to enhance their performance. Students can also formulate a revision strategy based on the exact gaps between examinations , rather than planning reactively once the schedule is out. 
 What to Expect in the Timetable? 
 Class 10 and 12 students can expect the following to be released on the official portal: 
 The main examination date sheet 
 Details on the board exam schedule for sports students 
 The Class 10 second board exam timeline 
 Class 12 supplementary exam dates 
 LOC Submission: A Mandatory Step 
 The board opened the portal for submitting the List of Candidates (LOC) for Class 10 and 12 on September 24 . Schools can submit candidates’ details without a late fee until October 21 , while submissions with a late fee will be accepted from October 22 to 26 . 
 CBSE has made clear that only students whose names are submitted through the online LOC submission process will be allowed to appear for the Class 10 and 12 board examinations — making this an essential administrative step schools must not miss. 
 LOC Registration Guidelines for Schools 
 According to the official circular, schools are required to complete their registration process before proceeding with the online submission of the LOC . Schools must use their ‘Affiliation Number’ as the user ID , which is already available to them, meaning no separate credential setup is required. 
 Syllabus Already Available? 
 Students preparing for the upcoming exams should note that the syllabus for Class 10 and 12 is already available on the CBSE website, cbseacademic.nic.in , allowing students to begin structured preparation even before the official date sheet is released. 
 Other Recent CBSE Announcements 
 Alongside the timetable update, CBSE has also been active on a few other fronts recently: 
 A national-level quiz on ‘Solid Waste Management’ for Classes 6 to 12 is being conducted on the Eco Clubs for Mission LiFE portal , open for participation from September 17 to October 17, 2026 
 CBSE will screen a sensitisation module on ‘Inclusive Education’ for school staff on October 7, 2026 , developed to build sensitivity, empathy, and inclusive attitudes toward Children with Special Needs (CwSN) , in line with directives from the Department of School Education and Literacy

 Why This Matters? 
 For the lakhs of students appearing for CBSE board exams each year, the combination of an early timetable announcement , an already-available syllabus , and clear LOC submission deadlines gives both students and schools a structured runway to prepare well in advance. Schools, in particular, need to ensure the LOC submission is completed accurately and on time , since any lapse here directly affects whether a student is permitted to sit for the board exams at all. Students and parents are advised to regularly check cbse.gov.in for the official date sheet release, rather than relying on unofficial estimates about the exact dates.
